subject: literacy
concept: Revising a draft thesis for argumentative clarity, coherence, and precision of language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student compares a rough draft passage to a revised version and identifies what improved
exercise.abstract: Student revises their own draft for clarity, logical flow, and precise language, explaining the changes made

assessment.mastery_threshold: revision shows genuine improvement in clarity or argument strength, not just surface-level word changes
misconception_flags: makes only cosmetic edits (word swaps) without addressing actual clarity or argument issues

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
